stench.name: Stench
stench.description: By releasing a stench when attacking, there is a 10% chance that targets damaged by the Critter’s moves will flinch. This does not stack with moves or items that have a chance to flinch.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.description: Summons rain for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Powers up Water-type moves by 50% and halves the damage of Fire-type moves.

speedBoost.name: Speed Boost
speedBoost.description: Boosts the Critter’s Speed stat at the end of every turn.

battleArmor.name: Battle Armor
battleArmor.description: Hard armor protects the Critter from critical hits.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: If the Critter has full HP and takes damage from a move that would knock it out in one hit, it will endure the hit with 1 HP. The Critter is also immune to one-hit KO moves.

damp.name: Damp
damp.description: The Critter dampens its surroundings, preventing all Critter from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct or dealing damage with Aftermath.

limber.name: Limber
limber.description: The Critter’s limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

sandVeil.name: Sand Veil
sandVeil.description: Boosts the Critter’s evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm. The Critter also takes no damage from sandstorms.

static.name: Static
static.description: The Critter is charged with static electricity and has a 30% chance to paralyze attackers that hit it with a contact move.

voltAbsorb.name: Volt Absorb
voltAbsorb.description: Electric-type moves do not work on the Critter. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

waterAbsorb.name: Water Absorb
waterAbsorb.description: Water-type moves do not work on the Critter. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.description: The Critter is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

compoundEyes.name: Compound Eyes
compoundEyes.description: The Critter’s compound eyes boost its accuracy by 30%.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.description: The Critter’s insomnia prevents it from becoming drowsy or being put to sleep.

colorChange.name: Color Change
colorChange.description: The Critter’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.description: The Critter’s immune system prevents it from being poisoned or badly poisoned.

flashFire.name: Flash Fire
flashFire.description: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Critter absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves by 50%.

shieldDust.name: Shield Dust
shieldDust.description: Protective dust shields the Critter from the additional effects of moves.

ownTempo.name: Own Tempo
ownTempo.description: The Critter sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

suctionCups.name: Suction Cups
suctionCups.description: The Critter uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.description: When the Critter enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Critter and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

shadowTag.name: Shadow Tag
shadowTag.description: The Critter steps on the opposing Critter’s shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

roughSkin.name: Rough Skin
roughSkin.description: The Critter’s rough skin damages attackers that hit it with contact moves for 1/8 of their max HP.

wonderGuard.name: Wonder Guard
wonderGuard.description: Its mysterious power only lets super effective moves hit the Critter.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.description: The Critter floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web.

effectSpore.name: Effect Spore
effectSpore.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep. Grass-type Critter are unaffected.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.description: If the Critter is burned, paralyzed, poisoned, or badly poisoned by another Critter’s move or Ability, that Critter will also be inflicted with the same status condition. If this Critter is your lead into battle, opposing wild Critter will share its nature.

clearBody.name: Clear Body
clearBody.description: The Critter’s stats cannot be lowered by other Critter’s moves or Abilities.

naturalCure.name: Natural Cure
naturalCure.description: The Critter’s status conditions are cured when it switches out of battle.

lightningRod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningRod.description: The Critter draws in all Electric-type moves. These moves do not work on the Critter. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat.

sereneGrace.name: Serene Grace
sereneGrace.description: Doubles the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Critter uses its moves. This does not affect items.

swiftSwim.name: Swift Swim
swiftSwim.description: Doubles the Critter’s Speed stat in rain.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.description: Doubles the Critter’s Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.description: By illuminating its surroundings, the Critter prevents its accuracy from being lowered and ignores changes to targets’ evasiveness. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Critter is on the field.

trace.name: Trace
trace.description: When the Critter enters a battle, it changes its Ability to match that of an opponent.

hugePower.name: Huge Power
hugePower.description: Doubles the power of the Critter’s physical moves.

poisonPoint.name: Poison Point
poisonPoint.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

innerFocus.name: Inner Focus
innerFocus.description: The Critter’s intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

magmaArmor.name: Magma Armor
magmaArmor.description: The Critter’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

waterVeil.name: Water Veil
waterVeil.description: The Critter’s water veil prevents it from being burned.

magnetPull.name: Magnet Pull
magnetPull.description: Prevents Steel-type Critter from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.description: Soundproofing gives the Critter full immunity to all sound-based moves.

rainDish.name: Rain Dish
rainDish.description: The Critter has 1/16 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in rain.

sandStream.name: Sand Stream
sandStream.description: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Critter that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types take damage equal to 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn. This also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types by 50%.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.description: Puts opposing Critter under pressure, causing them to expend 1 more PP when using moves against the Critter.

thickFat.name: Thick Fat
thickFat.description: The Critter is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

earlyBird.name: Early Bird
earlyBird.description: The Critter awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Critter.

flameBody.name: Flame Body
flameBody.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being burned.

runAway.name: Run Away
runAway.description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Critter, as well as ignoring any effect that would usually prevent the Critter from switching out.

keenEye.name: Keen Eye
keenEye.description: The Critter’s keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered and ignore changes to targets’ evasiveness.

hyperCutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyperCutter.description: The Critter’s prized, mighty pincers prevent other Critter’s moves or Abilities from lowering its Attack stat.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.description: The Critter may pick up an item another Critter used during a battle, even if it did not participate.

truant.name: Truant
truant.description: Each time the Critter uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.description: When the Critter uses physical moves, its Attack stat is boosted by 50%, but its accuracy is lowered by 20%.

cuteCharm.name: Cute Charm
cuteCharm.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of becoming infatuated if the attacker and the Critter are of opposite genders.

plus.name: Plus
plus.description: The Critter’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

minus.name: Minus
minus.description: The Critter’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.description: The Critter transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

stickyHold.name: Sticky Hold
stickyHold.description: The Critter’s held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be stolen or removed by other Critter.

shedSkin.name: Shed Skin
shedSkin.description: The Critter has a 30% chance of curing its own status conditions at the end of every turn by shedding its skin.

guts.name: Guts
guts.description: It’s so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Critter’s Attack stat by 50%. Being burned does not halve the damage dealt by the Critter’s physical moves.

marvelScale.name: Marvel Scale
marvelScale.description: The Critter’s marvelous scales boost its Defense stat by 50% if it has a status condition.

liquidOoze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquidOoze.description: The strong stench of the Critter’s oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves instead of healing them.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Grass-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Fire-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Water-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Bug-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

rockHead.name: Rock Head
rockHead.description: The Critter will not lose HP due to recoil damage from its moves.

drought.name: Drought
drought.description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Powers up Fire-type moves by 50% and halves the damage of Water-type moves.

arenaTrap.name: Arena Trap
arenaTrap.description: Prevents opposing Critter from fleeing or switching out. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Critter is on the field.

vitalSpirit.name: Vital Spirit
vitalSpirit.description: The Critter is full of vitality, and that prevents it from becoming drowsy or being put to sleep.

whiteSmoke.name: White Smoke
whiteSmoke.description: The Critter is protected by its white smoke, which prevents its stats from being lowered by other Critter’s moves or Abilities.

purePower.name: Pure Power
purePower.description: Using its pure power, the Critter doubles the power of its physical moves.

shellArmor.name: Shell Armor
shellArmor.description: A hard shell protects the Critter from critical hits.

tangledFeet.name: Tangled Feet
tangledFeet.description: Doubles the Critter’s evasiveness if it is confused.

motorDrive.name: Motor Drive
motorDrive.description: The Critter takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.description: The Critter’s competitive spirit boosts the power of its moves by 25% against targets of the same gender, and lowers it by 25% against targets of the opposite gender. The power remains the same as usual if either Critter’s gender is unknown.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.description: The Critter’s determination boosts its Speed stat when it flinches.

snowCloak.name: Snow Cloak
snowCloak.description: Boosts the Critter’s evasiveness by 25% in snow or hail. The Critter also takes no damage from hail.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.description: If the Critter is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP drops to 1/4 or less of its max, it will instead eat that Berry when its HP drops to 1/2 or less of its max.

angerPoint.name: Anger Point
angerPoint.description: The Critter is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.description: Doubles the Critter’s Speed stat when its held item is consumed or lost.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.description: The Critter’s heatproof body halves the damage taken from burns and Fire-type moves.

simple.name: Simple
simple.description: Doubles the effects of the Critter’s stat changes.

drySkin.name: Dry Skin
drySkin.description: Restores 1/4 of the Critter’s max HP when hit by Water-type moves or 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn in rain. However, the Critter receives 25% more damage from Fire-type moves and loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn in harsh sunlight.

download.name: Download
download.description: The Critter compares an opposing Critter’s Defense and Sp. Def stats before raising its own Attack or Sp. Atk stat — whichever will be more effective.

ironFist.name: Iron Fist
ironFist.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s punching moves by 20%.

poisonHeal.name: Poison Heal
poisonHeal.description: If poisoned or badly poisoned, the Critter has 1/8 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn instead of losing HP.

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.description: Boosts the power of moves of the same type as the Critter by 100% instead of 50%. Does not stack with the Stellar-type Tera boost.

skillLink.name: Skill Link
skillLink.description: The Critter’s multistrike moves always hit the max amount of times.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.description: Cures the Critter’s status conditions at the end of every turn in rain.

solarPower.name: Solar Power
solarPower.description: In harsh sunlight, the Critter’s Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50% but it loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn.

quickFeet.name: Quick Feet
quickFeet.description: When the Critter has a status condition, its Speed stat is boosted by 50%. Being paralyzed does not lower the Critter’s Speed stat.

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.description: All the Critter’s moves become Normal-type and their power is boosted by 20%.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s critical hits by 125% instead of 50%.

magicGuard.name: Magic Guard
magicGuard.description: The Critter takes damage only from attacks.

noGuard.name: No Guard
noGuard.description: The Critter employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Critter is on the field.

stall.name: Stall
stall.description: The Critter’s moves go last among moves of the same priority.

technician.name: Technician
technician.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s moves by 50% if their power is 60 or less.

leafGuard.name: Leaf Guard
leafGuard.description: The Critter is immune to status conditions in harsh sunlight.

klutz.name: Klutz
klutz.description: Items do not work when held by the Critter.

moldBreaker.name: Mold Breaker
moldBreaker.description: The Critter’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

superLuck.name: Super Luck
superLuck.description: The Critter is so lucky that its moves have their critical-hit ratio boosted by 1 stage.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.description: When the Critter is knocked out by a contact move, the attacker takes damage equal to 1/4 of their max HP.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.description: When the Critter enters a battle, it senses whether the opponents know any one-hit KO moves or moves that are super effective against it.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.description: When it enters a battle, the Critter can tell one of the moves an opposing Critter has.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.description: The Critter ignores the target’s stat changes when attacking, and ignores the attacker’s stat changes when being attacked. It cannot ignore changes to the Speed stat, however.

tintedLens.name: Tinted Lens
tintedLens.description: The Critter’s “not very effective” attacks deal double damage.

filter.name: Filter
filter.description: Reduces the damage the Critter takes from super effective moves by 25%.

slowStart.name: Slow Start
slowStart.description: For five turns, the Critter’s Attack and Speed stats are halved.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.description: The Critter can hit Ghost-type Critter with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

stormDrain.name: Storm Drain
stormDrain.description: The Critter draws in all Water-type moves. These moves do not work on the Critter. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat.

iceBody.name: Ice Body
iceBody.description: The Critter has 1/16 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in snow or hail. The Critter also takes no damage from hail.

solidRock.name: Solid Rock
solidRock.description: Reduces the damage the Critter takes from super effective moves by 25%.

snowWarning.name: Snow Warning
snowWarning.description: Summons snow for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Ice-type Pokemon have their Defense stat boosted by 50%.

honeyGather.name: Honey Gather
honeyGather.description: The Critter gathers Honey which is then sold for money after a battle is won, even if it did not participate.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.description: When it enters a battle, the Critter can check an opposing Critter’s Ability.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s moves by 20% if they have recoil or crash damage.

multitype.name: Multitype
multitype.description: Changes the Critter’s type to match the Plate it holds.

flowerGift.name: Flower Gift
flowerGift.description: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of the Critter and its allies by 50% in harsh sunlight.

badDreams.name: Bad Dreams
badDreams.description: Damages opposing Critter that are asleep at the end of every turn by 1/8 of their max HP.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, it will steal a held item from the attacker.

sheerForce.name: Sheer Force
sheerForce.description: The Critter’s moves lose their additional effects, but the power of those moves will be boosted by 30%.

contrary.name: Contrary
contrary.description: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Critter so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them — and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.description: Unnerves opposing Critter and makes them unable to eat Berries.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.description: When the Critter has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Attack stat is boosted sharply.

defeatist.name: Defeatist
defeatist.description: Halves the Critter’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

cursedBody.name: Cursed Body
cursedBody.description: When the Critter takes damage from a move, the attacker has a 30% chance to have whichever move it last used disabled for 4 turns.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: The Critter has a 50% chance of curing the status conditions of its allies at the end of every turn.

friendGuard.name: Friend Guard
friendGuard.description: Reduces the damage allies take by 25%.

weakArmor.name: Weak Armor
weakArmor.description: When the Critter takes damage from a physical move, its Defense stat is lowered, but its Speed stat is boosted sharply.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.description: Halves the damage the Critter takes while its HP is full.

toxicBoost.name: Toxic Boost
toxicBoost.description: When the Critter is poisoned or badly poisoned, the power of its physical moves is boosted by 50%.

flareBoost.name: Flare Boost
flareBoost.description: When the Critter is burned, the power of its special moves is boosted by 50%.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.description: If the Critter has used a Berry, it has a 50% chance of creating another one at the end of every turn. In harsh sunlight, the Critter is guaranteed to create a Berry.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.description: The Critter anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

moody.name: Moody
moody.description: At the end of every turn, one of the Critter’s stats will be boosted sharply, but another will be lowered. Accuracy and evasiveness are excluded.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.description: The Critter takes no damage from sandstorms or hail, and is immune to moves and Abilities involving powder or spores.

poisonTouch.name: Poison Touch
poisonTouch.description: When the Critter hits a target with a contact move, the target has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.description: The Critter has 1/3 of its max HP restored when it switches out of battle.

bigPecks.name: Big Pecks
bigPecks.description: The Critter’s Defense stat cannot be lowered by other Critter’s moves or Abilities.

sandRush.name: Sand Rush
sandRush.description: Doubles the Critter’s Speed stat in a sandstorm. The Critter also takes no damage from sandstorms.

wonderSkin.name: Wonder Skin
wonderSkin.description: Lowers the accuracy of status moves used against the Critter to 50%.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s move by 30% when the Critter is the last to move that turn.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.description: The Critter fools opponents by entering battle disguised as the last Critter in its party. It reverts to its usual appearance when it takes damage from a move.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.description: The Critter transforms into the Critter in front of it. It also copies all of that Critter’s stats apart from its HP. Copied moves have 5 PP each.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.description: When using its moves, the Critter ignores the effects of targets’ Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, and substitutes.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker has its Ability changed to Mummy.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.description: When the Critter knocks out a target with an attack, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

justified.name: Justified
justified.description: When the Critter is hit by a Dark-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.description: The Critter gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

magicBounce.name: Magic Bounce
magicBounce.description: Instead of being affected by other Critter’s status moves, the Critter bounces them back at the user.

sapSipper.name: Sap Sipper
sapSipper.description: Grass-type moves do not work on the Critter. Instead, they boost its Attack stat.

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.description: Increases the priority of the Critter’s status moves by 1 stage. However, the Critter’s status moves no longer work against Dark-type Critter.

sandForce.name: Sand Force
sandForce.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves by 30% in a sandstorm. The Critter also takes no damage from sandstorms.

ironBarbs.name: Iron Barbs
ironBarbs.description: The Critter’s iron barbs damage attackers that hit it with contact moves for 1/8 of their max HP.

zenMode.name: Zen Mode
zenMode.description: The Critter changes its form to Zen Mode when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

victoryStar.name: Victory Star
victoryStar.description: The Critter and its allies have their accuracy boosted by 10%.

turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.description: The Critter’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

teravolt.name: Teravolt
teravolt.description: The Critter’s moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target, with certain exceptions.

aromaVeil.name: Aroma Veil
aromaVeil.description: The Critter and its allies are protected from Infatuation, Taunt, Torment, Disable, Heal Block, and Encore.

flowerVeil.name: Flower Veil
flowerVeil.description: If the Critter or its allies are Grass-type, they are immune to status conditions and cannot have their stats lowered.

cheekPouch.name: Cheek Pouch
cheekPouch.description: The Critter has 1/3 of its max HP restored when it eats a Berry, in addition to the Berry’s usual effect.

protean.name: Protean
protean.description: Changes the Critter’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

furCoat.name: Fur Coat
furCoat.description: Halves the damage the Critter takes from physical moves.

magician.name: Magician
magician.description: The Critter steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.description: The Critter is immune to ball and bomb moves.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.description: When the Critter has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted sharply.

strongJaw.name: Strong Jaw
strongJaw.description: The Critter’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves by 50%.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.description: The Critter’s Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

sweetVeil.name: Sweet Veil
sweetVeil.description: The Critter and its allies cannot become drowsy or be put to sleep.

stanceChange.name: Stance Change
stanceChange.description: The Critter changes into its Blade Forme when it attacks and changes into its Shield Forme when it uses the move King’s Shield.

galeWings.name: Gale Wings
galeWings.description: Increases the priority of the Critter’s Flying-type moves by 1 stage while its HP is full.

megaLauncher.name: Mega Launcher
megaLauncher.description: Boosts the power of Aura Sphere and moves with “Pulse” in their names by 50%.

grassPelt.name: Grass Pelt
grassPelt.description: Boosts the Critter’s Defense stat by 50% on Grassy Terrain.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.description: When an ally consumes an item, the Critter gives its own held item to that ally.

toughClaws.name: Tough Claws
toughClaws.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s contact moves by 30%.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.description: The Critter’s Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker’s Speed stat is lowered.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.description: The Critter’s Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

parentalBond.name: Parental Bond
parentalBond.description: When the Critter attacks, its kin follows up with a second strike at 1/4 of the first attack’s power. This does not occur for multistrike moves or moves that target multiple Critter.

darkAura.name: Dark Aura
darkAura.description: Boosts the power of the Dark-type moves of all Critter on the field by 33%.

fairyAura.name: Fairy Aura
fairyAura.description: Boosts the power of the Fairy-type moves of all Critter on the field by 33%.

auraBreak.name: Aura Break
auraBreak.description: The effects of Fairy Aura and Dark Aura are reversed and nullified, causing affected moves to be 25% weaker.

primordialSea.name: Primordial Sea
primordialSea.description: The Critter changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks and increase the damage of Water-type moves by 50%.

desolateLand.name: Desolate Land
desolateLand.description: The Critter changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks and increase the damage of Fire-type moves by 50%.

deltaStream.name: Delta Stream
deltaStream.description: The Critter changes the weather so that no moves are super effective against the Flying type.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.description: When the Critter takes damage from a move, its Defense stat is boosted.

wimpOut.name: Wimp Out
wimpOut.description: The Critter cowardly switches out when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

emergencyExit.name: Emergency Exit
emergencyExit.description: The Critter, sensing danger, switches out when its HP drops to 1/2 or less.

waterCompaction.name: Water Compaction
waterCompaction.description: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Critter is hit by a Water-type move.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.description: The Critter’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

shieldsDown.name: Shields Down
shieldsDown.description: The Critter’s shell protects it from status conditions. When its HP drops to 1/2 or less, the shell breaks and it becomes aggressive, changing into its Core Form.

stakeout.name: Stakeout
stakeout.description: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

waterBubble.name: Water Bubble
waterBubble.description: Halves the damage the Critter takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Critter cannot be burned.

steelworker.name: Steelworker
steelworker.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Steel-type moves by 50%.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: Boosts the Critter’s Sp. Atk stat when an attack causes its HP to drop to 1/2 or less of its max.

slushRush.name: Slush Rush
slushRush.description: Doubles the Critter’s Speed stat in snow or hail. The Critter also takes no damage from hail.

longReach.name: Long Reach
longReach.description: None of the moves used by the Critter are considered contact moves.

liquidVoice.name: Liquid Voice
liquidVoice.description: The Critter’s sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

triage.name: Triage
triage.description: Increases the priority of the Critter’s healing moves by 3 stages.

galvanize.name: Galvanize
galvanize.description: The Critter’s Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

surgeSurfer.name: Surge Surfer
surgeSurfer.description: Doubles the Critter’s Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

schooling.name: Schooling
schooling.description: The Critter forms a powerful school when it reaches level 20. It stops schooling when its HP drops to 1/4 or less.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.description: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Critter can protect it from an attack at the cost of losing 1/8 of its max HP.

battleBond.name: Battle Bond
battleBond.description: Once per switch-in when the Critter knocks out a target, its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted. If a Ondeux has this ability, it instead transforms into Ash-Ondeux whenever it knocks out a target.

powerConstruct.name: Power Construct
powerConstruct.description: Cells gather to aid the Critter when its HP drops to 1/2 or less, causing it to change into its Complete Forme.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.description: The Critter can poison or badly poison targets even if they’re Steel or Poison types.

comatose.name: Comatose
comatose.description: The Critter is always drowsing and can attack while in its sleeping state. It is considered under the effects of a status condition.

queenlyMajesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenlyMajesty.description: The Critter’s majesty pressures opponents and makes them unable to use priority moves against the Critter or its allies.

innardsOut.name: Innards Out
innardsOut.description: When the Critter takes damage from a move that knocks it out, it deals the same amount of damage to the attacker.

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.description: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Critter will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Powers up special moves used by allies by 30%.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

dazzling.name: Dazzling
dazzling.description: The Critter dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Critter or its allies.

soulHeart.name: Soul-Heart
soulHeart.description: Boosts the Critter’s Sp. Atk stat every time another Critter faints.

tanglingHair.name: Tangling Hair
tanglingHair.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker’s Speed stat is lowered.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.description: The Critter changes its Ability to match that of a defeated ally in a Double Battle.

powerOfAlchemy.name: Power of Alchemy
powerOfAlchemy.description: The Critter changes its Ability to match that of a defeated ally in a Double Battle.

beastBoost.name: Beast Boost
beastBoost.description: Boosts the Critter’s most proficient stat every time it knocks out a target.

rksSystem.name: RKS System
rksSystem.description: Changes the Critter’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

electricSurge.name: Electric Surge
electricSurge.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Critter on the ground have their Electric-type moves boosted by 30% and cannot be put to sleep.

psychicSurge.name: Psychic Surge
psychicSurge.description: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Critter on the ground have their Psychic-type moves boosted by 30% and cannot use or be targeted by moves with increased priority.

mistySurge.name: Misty Surge
mistySurge.description: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Critter on the ground are protected from status conditions and receive half the damage dealt by Dragon-type moves.

grassySurge.name: Grassy Surge
grassySurge.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Critter enters a battle. Critter on the ground have their Grass-type moves boosted by 30% and restore 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn.

fullMetalBody.name: Full Metal Body
fullMetalBody.description: The Critter’s stats cannot be lowered by other Critter’s moves or Abilities. This effect cannot be ignored.

shadowShield.name: Shadow Shield
shadowShield.description: Halves the damage the Critter takes while its HP is full. This effect cannot be ignored by other Critter’s moves or Abilities.

prismArmor.name: Prism Armor
prismArmor.description: Reduces the damage the Critter takes from super effective moves by 25%. This effect cannot be ignored by other Critter’s moves or Abilities.

neuroforce.name: Neuroforce
neuroforce.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s moves that are super effective against the target by 25%.

intrepidSword.name: Intrepid Sword
intrepidSword.description: Boosts the Critter’s Attack stat when the Critter enters a battle.

dauntlessShield.name: Dauntless Shield
dauntlessShield.description: Boosts the Critter’s Defense stat when the Critter enters a battle.

libero.name: Libero
libero.description: Changes the Critter’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.

ballFetch.name: Ball Fetch
ballFetch.description: The Critter will fetch the Capture Orb from the first failed throw of the battle, even if it did not participate.

cottonDown.name: Cotton Down
cottonDown.description: When the Critter is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Critter except itself.

propellerTail.name: Propeller Tail
propellerTail.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Critter’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

mirrorArmor.name: Mirror Armor
mirrorArmor.description: Instead of being affected by stat-lowering effects, the Critter bounces them back at whichever Critter caused them.

gulpMissile.name: Gulp Missile
gulpMissile.description: When the Critter uses Surf or Dive, it returns with prey. If the Critter is hit by a move, it spits out its prey at the attacker, dealing damage equal to 1/4 of the attacker’s max HP. This also lowers the attacker’s Defense stat or paralyzes it, depending on the caught prey.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.description: The Critter ignores the effects of Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

steamEngine.name: Steam Engine
steamEngine.description: Boosts the Speed stat by 6 stages when the Critter is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

punkRock.name: Punk Rock
punkRock.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s sound-based moves by 30% and halves the damage the Critter takes from sound-based moves.

sandSpit.name: Sand Spit
sandSpit.description: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Critter takes damage from moves. Critter that are not Rock, Ground, or Steel types take damage equal to 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn. This also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types by 50%.

iceScales.name: Ice Scales
iceScales.description: The Critter is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

ripen.name: Ripen
ripen.description: Ripens and doubles the effect of berries eaten by the Critter.

iceFace.name: Ice Face
iceFace.description: The Critter’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, the ice will be restored when it begins to snow or hail.

powerSpot.name: Power Spot
powerSpot.description: Just being next to the Critter powers up the moves of its allies by 30%.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.description: The Critter’s type changes depending on the terrain.

screenCleaner.name: Screen Cleaner
screenCleaner.description: When the Critter enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Critter.

steelySpirit.name: Steely Spirit
steelySpirit.description: Boosts the power of Steel-type moves used by the Critter and its allies by 50%.

perishBody.name: Perish Body
perishBody.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the Critter and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle. Boss Critter are immune to this effect.

wanderingSpirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wanderingSpirit.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, it swaps Abilities with the attacker.

gorillaTactics.name: Gorilla Tactics
gorillaTactics.description: Boosts the Critter’s Attack stat by 50%, but only allows the use of the first selected move.

neutralizingGas.name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizingGas.description: While the Critter is in the battle, the effects of all other Critter’s Abilities and Passives will be nullified or will not be triggered.

pastelVeil.name: Pastel Veil
pastelVeil.description: The Critter and its allies are protected from being poisoned or badly poisoned.

hungerSwitch.name: Hunger Switch
hungerSwitch.description: The Critter changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

quickDraw.name: Quick Draw
quickDraw.description: The Critter’s moves have a 30% chance of going first among moves of the same priority.

unseenFist.name: Unseen Fist
unseenFist.description: When the Critter uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

curiousMedicine.name: Curious Medicine
curiousMedicine.description: When the Critter enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Electric-type moves by 30%.

dragonsMaw.name: Dragon’s Maw
dragonsMaw.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Dragon-type moves by 50%.

chillingNeigh.name: Chilling Neigh
chillingNeigh.description: When the Critter knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

grimNeigh.name: Grim Neigh
grimNeigh.description: When the Critter knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

asOneGlastrier.name: As One
asOneGlastrier.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Unnerve and Chilling Neigh, preventing opposing Critter from consuming berries and boosting the Critter’s Attack stat when knocking out a target.

asOneSpectrier.name: As One
asOneSpectrier.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Unnerve and Grim Neigh, preventing opposing Critter from consuming berries and boosting the Critter’s Sp. Atk stat when knocking out a target.

lingeringAroma.name: Lingering Aroma
lingeringAroma.description: When the Critter is hit by a contact move, the attacker has its Ability changed to Lingering Aroma.

seedSower.name: Seed Sower
seedSower.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns when the Critter takes damage from moves. Critter on the ground have their Grass-type moves boosted by 30% and restore 1/16 of their max HP at the end of every turn.

thermalExchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermalExchange.description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Critter is hit by a Fire-type move. The Critter also cannot be burned.

angerShell.name: Anger Shell
angerShell.description: When an attack causes its HP to drop to 1/2 or less, the Critter gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

purifyingSalt.name: Purifying Salt
purifyingSalt.description: The Critter’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

wellBakedBody.name: Well-Baked Body
wellBakedBody.description: The Critter takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

windRider.name: Wind Rider
windRider.description: Boosts the Critter’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Critter is hit by a wind move. The Critter also takes no damage from wind moves.

guardDog.name: Guard Dog
guardDog.description: Boosts the Critter’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Critter to switch out also fail to work.

rockyPayload.name: Rocky Payload
rockyPayload.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Rock-type moves by 50%.

windPower.name: Wind Power
windPower.description: The Critter becomes charged when Tailwind takes effect or it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Critter uses.

zeroToHero.name: Zero to Hero
zeroToHero.description: The Critter transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out of battle.

commander.name: Commander
commander.description: Upon entering battle, the Critter goes inside an ally Mario if one is on the field and raises all its stats sharply. Raises the likelihood of Double Battles while this Critter is on the field.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.description: When the Critter takes damage from a move, the power of the next Electric-type move used by the Critter will be doubled.

protosynthesis.name: Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.description: Boosts the Critter’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

quarkDrive.name: Quark Drive
quarkDrive.description: Boosts the Critter’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is its Speed stat.

goodAsGold.name: Good as Gold
goodAsGold.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Critter full immunity to other Critter’s status moves.

vesselOfRuin.name: Vessel of Ruin
vesselOfRuin.description: The power of the Critter’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Critter except itself by 25% while on the field.

swordOfRuin.name: Sword of Ruin
swordOfRuin.description: The power of the Critter’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Critter except itself by 25% while on the field.

tabletsOfRuin.name: Tablets of Ruin
tabletsOfRuin.description: The power of the Critter’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Critter except itself by 25% while on the field.

beadsOfRuin.name: Beads of Ruin
beadsOfRuin.description: The power of the Critter’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Critter except itself by 25% while on the field.

orichalcumPulse.name: Orichalcum Pulse
orichalcumPulse.description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up Fire-type moves by 50% and halves the power of Water-type moves. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Critter also boosts its Attack stat by 33% in harsh sunlight.

hadronEngine.name: Hadron Engine
hadronEngine.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when entering a battle, which powers up the Electric-type moves of Critter on the ground by 30% and prevents them from falling asleep. The futuristic engine within the Critter also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: When an opponent’s stats are boosted, the Critter seizes the opportunity to boost its own stats in the exact same way.

cudChew.name: Cud Chew
cudChew.description: If the Critter eats a Berry, it will regurgitate and eat that same Berry once more at the end of next turn.

sharpness.name: Sharpness
sharpness.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s slicing moves by 50%.

supremeOverlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supremeOverlord.description: When the Critter enters a battle, the power of its moves is boosted by 10% for each Critter in its party that has been defeated in battle already. The maximum boost is 50%

costar.name: Costar
costar.description: When the Critter enters a battle, it copies its ally’s stat changes.

toxicDebris.name: Toxic Debris
toxicDebris.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Critter takes damage from physical moves. Opposing Critter that land on these spikes when switching into battle will be poisoned. A second layer of spikes will instead badly poison. Poison-types that land on these spikes will absorb and remove them from the field.

armorTail.name: Armor Tail
armorTail.description: The mysterious tail covering the Critter’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Critter or its allies.

earthEater.name: Earth Eater
earthEater.description: Ground-type moves do not work on the Critter. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

myceliumMight.name: Mycelium Might
myceliumMight.description: The Critter’s status moves will go last among moves of the same priority, but these moves will be unaffected by the Ability of the target.

mindsEye.name: Mind’s Eye
mindsEye.description: The Critter ignores changes to opponents’ evasiveness, its accuracy can’t be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

supersweetSyrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweetSyrup.description: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field when the Critter enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Critter.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.description: When the Critter enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring 1/4 of its ally’s max HP.

toxicChain.name: Toxic Chain
toxicChain.description: When the Critter hits a target with a move, the target has a 30% chance of being badly poisoned from the power of the Critter’s toxic chain.

embodyAspectTeal.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectTeal.description: The Critter’s heart fills with memories, causing the Teal Mask to shine and the Critter’s Speed stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectWellspring.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectWellspring.description: The Critter’s heart fills with memories, causing the Wellspring Mask to shine and the Critter’s Sp. Def stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectHearthflame.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectHearthflame.description: The Critter’s heart fills with memories, causing the Hearthflame Mask to shine and the Critter’s Attack stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectCornerstone.name: Embody Aspect
embodyAspectCornerstone.description: The Critter’s heart fills with memories, causing the Cornerstone Mask to shine and the Critter’s Defense stat to be boosted.

teraShift.name: Tera Shift
teraShift.description: When the Critter enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

teraShell.name: Tera Shell
teraShell.description: The Critter’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Critter when its HP is full will not be very effective.

teraformZero.name: Teraform Zero
teraformZero.description: The Critter uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

poisonPuppeteer.name: Poison Puppeteer
poisonPuppeteer.description: Critter poisoned or badly poisoned by this Critter’s moves will also become confused.

piercingDrill.name: Piercing Drill
piercingDrill.description: When the Critter uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target’s protective effects is still triggered.

dragonize.name: Dragonize
dragonize.description: The Critter’s Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

eelevate.name: Eelevate
eelevate.description: The Critter floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web. When the Critter knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

megaSol.name: Mega Sol
megaSol.description: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Critter can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

fireMane.name: Fire Mane
fireMane.description: Boosts the power of the Critter’s Fire-type moves by 50%.

spicySpray.name: Spicy Spray
spicySpray.description: When the Critter takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

auraGuard.name: Aura Guard
auraGuard.description: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact.
